title: Next step
description: One step of nextSteps in an error body or a result: who does it, what, and everything needed to do it. Steps run first to last. The agent does AGENT steps and shows PERSON steps (command and url unchanged) to the person. A PERSON step is a link to a page; the agent's own basalt init prints that link. Commands are complete and never carry a secret. Which actions go with which actor: CONTRACT.md, Next steps.

action.description: AGENT: CALL_TOOL, REVISE_CALL, RETRY_SMALLER_BATCHES, ASK_PERSON, END_TURN, STOP, SEND_REQUEST (send the person the requestFile beside a hash link, as a file or its text blocks; first step, only when requestFile is present), and RUN_COMMAND (basalt init, which prints the link the person opens; on an agent-operated engine also a machine step on the engine's machine; never one that needs the admin). PERSON: OPEN_LINK, RUN_COMMAND (only the engine's start, a root fix on the engine's machine, and plugin steps), TELL_AGENT.

text.description: One plain sentence. A PERSON step is written to the person, an AGENT step to the agent.

tool.description: CALL_TOOL and REVISE_CALL: the tool to call.

arguments.description: CALL_TOOL: the tool's arguments, complete, filled in by the engine. With repeatCall they are merged over the arguments of the call that returned this step; a null value removes that argument. REVISE_CALL: the arguments the engine can fill in (ids); the agent adds the rest (an intent, a statement) as text says.

repeatCall.description: CALL_TOOL: repeat the same call with arguments merged in.

command.description: RUN_COMMAND: the complete command to run in a terminal on the engine's machine: for an AGENT step basalt init or a machine step; for a PERSON step the engine's start, a root fix or a plugin step (text says which).

url.description: OPEN_LINK: the link to open. May carry a short link's #s= secret; it is meant for the person.

maxRows.description: RETRY_SMALLER_BATCHES: the most rows one write may touch, cascades included.

waitSeconds.description: CALL_TOOL: wait this long before the call (a retry).
